review_kind: Independent read-only source review; no additional execution or formal proof claimed.
scope: Five supported native UC2/tutorial fixtures, current-state Flatland 4.3 dynamics, asynchronous UI inference integration.
findings: prepare/infer/finalize requires a complete joint batch; worker inputs are owned and native environment reads stay outside the inference worker.
Elapsed-step/reset staleness is rejected; final joint withdrawal runs synchronously under the session mutation lock before the existing human override layer.
Pause/reset/actor-change locking, cancellation drain and post-inference pause recheck remain intact.

The UC2 off-map mask matches native Flatland 4.3: positive malfunction counters wait; a cleared counter plus departure eligibility permits physically distinct FORWARD and STOP; NOOP stays off-map for that tick.
The original sufficient-certificate algorithm is reused, rather than weakened to force motion.
limits: The certificate addresses sufficient remaining reachability relative to the current baseline, not horizon completion, liveness or optimality.
A new malfunction at the next native step can invalidate the prediction; subsequent observed state is checked again. Human overrides follow autonomous certification.

ROAM topology tables are constructed once. Dynamic rail closures would require rebuilding them; the locked supported presets reject additional disturbances, so this is outside the declared runtime scope.
